title: Altered Carbon
author: Richard K. Morgan
summary: In a future where minds can be stored and moved between bodies, a hard-edged former soldier is revived in a stranger's body to investigate the apparent suicide of a very rich man. The rich man claims it was murder.
readIf: you like violent, noir-flavoured science fiction with a cynical lead and a twisty case.
skipIf: you are put off by graphic violence, torture and a bleak view of the powerful.

pairings.reason: The foundational cyberpunk novel this one is indebted to, a stylish, stranger and less violent read.
The classic private-eye story in which a cynical detective is hired by a rich family with a lot to hide.
A space-opera mystery with a similarly gritty detective at its centre.
